title: Brawl-Ket
tagline: A one-on-one fighting game where only a hit in your rival's colour hurts.
description: A small Street Fighter-style brawler for two: health bars, light and heavy attacks, specials and supers, best of 3 rounds of 60 seconds. The quantum twist is one visible rule: each fighter is in a measurement basis, shown by their body colour, green or purple, and only an attack of the matching colour hurts them. Switch your own colour to make their hits bounce off. Seven fighters, among them BOHR, ERWIN the cat and ALICE & BOB, five stages, and a CPU opponent on three levels.

keyboard.p1: W A S D to walk, jump and crouch, B to hit in your colour, V to hit in the other colour, G for a special, C to switch colour, B+V for a super, Space to pause
keyboard.p2: Arrows to walk, jump and crouch, L to hit in your colour, K to hit in the other colour, I for a special, J to switch colour, L+K for a super, Enter to pause

how_to_play: Knock your rival out. First to 2 rounds wins.
Only a hit in their body colour hurts: green hits green, purple hits purple, anything else bounces off.
A hits in your own colour, B in the other colour, X is a special move, Y switches your colour.
A+B fires your super once its bar is full.
Start (Space or Enter) pauses the game.
